items.title: Centene (CNC) Stock Fair Value Rises After Analysts Back Margin Recovery
items.summary: Centene's assessed fair value has shifted from US$63.78 to US$71.67, a move that signals a higher valuation framework in current models. Recent analyst commentary connects these higher targets to expectations for cleaner margins, steadier earnings quality and a more supportive view of capital returns, even as Medicaid exposure and policy risk remain key watch points. As you read on, you will see how to track this evolving Centene story and what to watch as the narrative changes over...
